import hashlib,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
torch.set_num_threads(2)
torch.manual_seed(20260908)
started=time.perf_counter()
q,k,v=[torch.randn(8,h,93,128,dtype=torch.bfloat16).double().requires_grad_() for h in (32,8,8)]
mask=torch.ones(8,93,dtype=torch.bool)
mask[1,0]=False
mask[0,-3:]=False
ids=torch.arange(93)
keep=(ids[None,:,None]>=ids[None,None,:])&mask[:,None,:]
valid=keep.any(-1)
scores=torch.einsum("bghqd,bgkd->bghqk",q.reshape(8,8,4,93,128),k)
scores=(scores*128**-0.5).masked_fill(~keep[:,None,None],-torch.inf)
scores=torch.where(valid[:,None,None,:,None],scores,torch.zeros_like(scores))
weights=torch.where(valid[:,None,None,:,None],scores.softmax(-1),torch.zeros_like(scores))
oracle=torch.einsum("bghqk,bgkd->bghqd",weights,v).reshape(8,32,93,128).transpose(1,2)
ref_q,ref_k,ref_v=[x.detach().clone().requires_grad_() for x in (q,k,v)]
native=F.scaled_dot_product_attention(ref_q,ref_k.repeat_interleave(4,1),ref_v.repeat_interleave(4,1),attn_mask=keep[:,None],dropout_p=0.0,scale=128**-0.5).transpose(1,2)
gradient=torch.randn_like(oracle,dtype=torch.bfloat16).double()
oracle.backward(gradient)
native.backward(gradient)
rows=[]
for name,a,b in [("output",oracle,native),("q_grad",q.grad,ref_q.grad),("k_grad",k.grad,ref_k.grad),("v_grad",v.grad,ref_v.grad)]:
    assert torch.isfinite(a).all() and torch.isfinite(b).all()
    torch.testing.assert_close(a,b,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
    rows.append({"name":name,"shape":list(a.shape),"numel":a.numel(),"max_abs_difference":(a-b).abs().max().item(),"status":"pass"})
assert torch.all(oracle[~valid]==0) and torch.all(native[~valid]==0)
block_count=keep.any((-1,-2)).int().tolist()
